description.zh: 标准化 DCF 估值引擎：AI 负责前瞻判断，引擎负责数据与计算，同样的输入永远得到同样的估值结果。A股、港股无需任何密钥；美股、日股有每日免费体验额度。
description.en: A standardized DCF valuation engine. The AI reasons about each assumption, the engine owns the data and the math — same inputs always produce the same valuation. A-shares and HK need no key; US and Japan have a daily free trial.
